LESSON: MONEY

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.5: Money

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Money. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-195.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 195]]

From your pupil's book (page 195)

Week 11 Lesson 3 Adding and subtracting money

Example 1 sh. Mary had sh. 345. Her mother 345 gave her sh. 225 more. How much + 225 money did she have altogether? 570 Example 2 sh. Maurice had sh. 32 He spent 32 sh 16. How much money was he - 16 left with? 16

Work to do 1. Peter bought sugar for sh.176. He also bought flour for sh 206. How much did he spend altogether? 2. Babu spent sh 341 at the market. He spent sh.270 on transport. How much did he spend altogether? 3. A family spends sh.514 on lunch. It also spends sh.275 on super. How much does it spend altogether?

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-256.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 256]]

From your pupil's book (page 256)

MONEY Week 8 Lesson 1 Relating money to goods and services Picture showing goods and services Unga Matatu Doctor

Sh 900 Sh 50 Sh 850 Work to do : Fill in as a good or a service Item Good or Service Amount Hair cut Service sh.50 Flask Good sh. 300 Transport sh. 200 Cloth repair sh. 100 Book sh 400 Pencil sh. 20 School Sweater sh. 800 Shoe repair sh. 50

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-099.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 99]]

From your pupil's book (page 99)

MONEY Week 10 Lesson 3 Kenya currency notes

Work to do Write what you can see in the Kenyan currency notes.

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Money means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Money.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Money
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
